user_decision: 先固定九组资源，优化后再评估扩容
phase: fixed existing nine groups before any expansion comparison

frozen_compiler_resource_profile.scope: deterministic compiler abstraction; not RTL/VIP or device calibration

external_budget_status: The old profile has no qualified device capacity or bandwidth. Device calibration must be explicit and retained across fixed-resource optimizations; its selection must not silently increase resources to meet a target.
bounded_allocator_64_GiB: Capacity diagnostic only, not an approved expansion, physical memory selection, bandwidth measurement or performance baseline.
algorithm_20_percent_rule: Only DP search/scheduling changes under identical hardware, recipes, precision, memory budget and workload count toward algorithm-only improvement.
hardware_candidates: Issue238/PR239 stays separate from the frozen hardware baseline; evaluate only as a labeled hardware change. More macros/bandwidth are deferred until the fixed-nine case is assessed.
acceptance_unchanged: B1/P512/D128 generation speed and J/token must both meet the qualified public FPGA comparison; P128/P2048 supplementary. No current end-to-end acceptance.
